title: 10 Costs a Godly Man Pays Before Anyone Calls Him a Leader
caption:
10 costs a godly man pays before anyone calls him a leader. Nobody claps for most of them.

He apologizes first. He takes blame that isn't fully his. He shows up on the day nobody's watching and gets corrected in front of people without flinching. He gives away credit, stays when the group gets smaller, and keeps leading after it stops paying off.

Christ didn't lead by being served. He led by giving everything away.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
